# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Alhaa hedhdhevi kalakko!
Hasuvaameenge dheelathi vaatha kamua alhaa ufadhdhavaa fai vanee Hasuvaameenge ah alhukan kusumahttakai kamah alhu hekivameve. Mihin'dhu alhu hehivameve. Alhaa ge mikamethi Hasuvaameenge kulhadhun vantha kamah adhi alhaa ge mikamethi kamashaai Hasuvaameenge fudhi—vodigen vaa kameve. Hasuvaameenge fiyavai Haahaku neiy kamashaai hunihaa kamakah ekalaange dhemivodigen vaa kamah hekivaaieve.
